title: chore(spec)!: retire the compactLayout alias + transition mirror (ADR-0085 window closed)
body:
Executes [#2536](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/issues/2536) — the trigger condition is met: objectui#2168 (consumer switch) shipped via the console pin #2526, and a full release window has passed (#2527, #2535).

## What
- `ObjectSchema` **drops `compactLayout`**: `create()` rejects it like any unknown key (loud, names the key); lenient `parse()` strips it. No silent aliasing in either direction.
- `normalizeSemanticRoleAliases` loses the alias **and** the `highlightFields → compactLayout` back-fill mirror (added in #2521 after browser dogfood). Served metadata carries the canonical key only.
- **27 straggler authors migrated** — system objects in plugin-audit/approvals/security/sharing/webhooks + service-storage/automation/messaging/realtime that the #2521 sweep missed (it only covered platform-objects). The `create()` type gate caught the first straggler at build time; a repo-wide grep found the rest. Zero authors remain.
- **Load-bearing assertion flipped as designed**: the #2528 dogfood mirror assertion existed to force this PR to prove absence — it now asserts `compactLayout: undefined` on served meta.
- liveness ledger row removed; `showcase_semantic_zoo_legacy` fixture keeps its `stageField: false` duty and authors the canonical key.
- Downstream smoke pin → **hotcrm v1.2.2** ([hotcrm#424](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/pull/424): same rename + deps ^11.7.0), same digestion flow as #2524.

## Verification
- spec: 6666 tests green (alias test rewritten to assert reject/strip); `check:api-surface` **unchanged**; `check:liveness` ✓
- dogfood: 181 tests green incl. the flipped semantic-roles assertions
- full dependency-closure build green (the straggler hunt was driven by it)

## Version
`@objectstack/spec` minor with a documented exception (same path as the 11.7.0 ADR-0085 removals): deprecated-with-alias for a full window, zero first-party authors/consumers remain, no export-surface change. Release owner has the final word per ADR-0059 §4.

Closes #2536
